articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor left AWS GovCloud keys sprawled across GitHub like classified docs at Mar-a-Lago. When the cybersecurity agency can't secure its own shit, you know we're living in the best timeline.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: Google claims API key deletion is "immediate" but researcher finds 23-minute window of lulz. That's enough time to grab data, rack up bills, or order pizza on someone else's dime.

articles.title: Attackers spill plaintext passwords of 46k Myspace93 users after 2021 breach
articles.summary: HackerOne slashes bug bounty payouts by 75% because apparently finding critical flaws should be a charity hobby. Way to incentivize the good guys, you absolute geniuses.

articles.title: Showboat Linux Malware Hits Middle East Telecom with SOCKS5 Proxy Backdoor
articles.summary: Cisco serves up another perfect 10 CVSS score with admin bypass flaw in Secure Workload. Nothing says "enterprise security" like letting attackers hop between tenant boundaries.

articles.title: When Identity is the Attack Path
articles.summary: Microsoft's Defender is actively being exploited for privilege escalation and DoS attacks. The irony of security software becoming the attack vector never gets old.

articles.title: Linus Torvalds admits he has a 'love-hate relationship with AI'
articles.summary: Nine-year-old Linux kernel flaw finally surfaces, proving that sometimes the best bugs age like fine wine. Root execution on major distros, because why not?

articles.title: Trump Mobile Hit With Fresh Humiliation
articles.summary: GitHub loses 3,800 internal repos to poisoned VS Code extension because even developers fall for social engineering. TeamPCP probably having a good laugh right about now.

articles.title: Your Privacy Shouldn't Be A Corporate Decision
articles.summary: Microsoft finally shows some human rights accountability while Google and Amazon continue enabling authoritarian surveillance. One tech giant grows a conscience, film at 11.

articles.title: How CISOs Should Prep for Agentic-Ready AI BOMs
articles.summary: EFF drops new guide on fighting back against normalized digital surveillance in the Americas. Because apparently we need instructions on why mass spying is bad.

articles.title: Cyber resilience defines SME competitiveness
articles.summary: Microsoft rolls out mitigations for YellowKey BitLocker bypass after researchers publicly dropped the exploit. Nothing motivates Redmond like public embarrassment.
